sentences.text: It is the case of the Prosecution that the informant is the wife of the accused.
During the year 2010 her marriage was solemnized with this accused.

He has demanded and taken cash of Rs.15,00,000/-
and 600 grams gold along with two houses situated at Bagalur near Airport at Bengaluru.
After the marriage, the informant had joined the accused.
But however the accused started demanded further dowry and the informant was tortured physically and mentally.
The informant was pushed out of his house on dire consequences.
The informant had been to the Police Station and lodged the information against the accused.
3. Based on the First Information of CW1, the crime was registered in Crime No.626/2011 at J.P.Nagar Police Station.
The accused has voluntarily surrendered produced before this Court and released on bail.

On completion of the investigation, the Police Sub-Inspector of J.P.Nagar Police Station, Bengaluru City filed Police Report against the accused alleging that he has committed the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.
After taking cognizance of the said offences, the process was issued to the accused.
The copies of the Police Report and other prosecution papers are furnished to the accused under Section 207 of Cr.P.C.

After hearing, since there were grounds for presuming that the accused has committed the offences triable by this Court,
charges for the offences has been framed and read over to him in Kannada language.
He has pleaded not guilty and claims to be tried.
4. To prove the charges framed against the accused, the Prosecution has produced the oral evidence of PW1 and documentary evidences as per Ex.P1 to Ex.P5.

Since, there were no incriminating circumstances appearing in the evidences of the prosecution witnesses against the accused, the examination of the accused under Section 313 of Cr.P.C. was dispensed with.
Heard the arguments of learned Senior Assistant Public Prosecutor and the learned Counsel for the accused.
Perused the materials available on record.
5. Heard the arguments of learned Senior Assistant Public Prosecutor and the learned counsel for the accused.
Perused the materials available on record.

6. The points for determination are;
1. Whether prosecution has proved beyond all reasonable doubts that the accused has committed the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 506 of the Indian Penal Code ?
2. What order or sentence?
7. My answers to the above points are as follows:

Point No.1 : In the Negative,

sentences.text: . POINT No.1 :- It is the case of the Prosecution that this accused has taken huge amount from the informant at the time of marriage.
This accused tortured the informant physically and mentally.
The case was register against the accused for offences punishable under Sections 498A and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.
After due investigation Final Report was submitted against the accused.
9. On perusal, the information was lodged during the year 2013.
The offences alleged against these accused are under Sections 498A and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.
The matter is pending since 2013.

In the Family Court Appeal No.195/2019 passed by the Hon'ble High Court of the State of Telangana at Hyderabad dated 10.01.2020, the matter is already settled between the parties and the informant has undertaken to withdraw this information.

entities.text: High Court of the State of Telangana at Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
However, this Court has issued summons,
warrant and proclamation to CW1 to CW4.
But, CW1 to CW4 have not turned to this court might be for the said settlement mentioned supra. CW1
as per the settlement has taken the amount in the Open Court.
Hence, the examination of CW1 to CW4 are dropped by rejecting the prayer of the learned Senior APP.
Hence, there is no evidence available before this Court to prove the guilt of the accused beyond all reasonable doubt.
Hence, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
10. Point No.2:

In view of the Negative findings on the above Point No.1, I proceed to pass the following:-
ORDERS Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C, the accused is hereby acquitted for the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.
His bail bonds and surety bond will be canceled after appeal period.
(Typed by the Stenographer in the Court Computer on my direct dictation, printout taken, corrected and then pronounced by me in the open court on 12.03.2025)
